pages.quiz:
WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.

6. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

9. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

10. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Timber Defects and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

2. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

4. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

7. B — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

11. C — Information and Communication Technology

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Portable Power Tools; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Woodworking Machines; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Timber Defects; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Manufactured boards; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
